nodes.title: Owner: voice is a MAJOR signal of whether the child understood. Built as knowledge/metacognitive states (uncertain-correct, confident-wrong, searching vs not-known, guessing, fluent recall), not emotions. Features + model run on the device or self-hosted (training on AWS GPU credits); per-child baselines in Neon; no Microsoft AI service infers anything from voice. This supersedes the signals spec's 'voice stays minor until Microsoft answers' stance for knowledge states. Emotion-from-voice is at most a shadow research arm. Workstream wf_085e782c-74c.
